messages.subject: TITANRunner pipeline stalling before complete
parts:
I'm seeing errors and warnings in my batch log file just after the RunTitan stage.  When this happens, I see jobs sitting in the SGE queue in 'qw' state, but they never seem to run (left them sitting over a weekend on one attempt, they never ran).  All stages before RunTitan look like the 'MergeTumourAllelicCounts' stage below, with 'Starting' messages followed by 'Completed Sucessfully!'

When I eventually give up and 'qdel' the jobs, I get a 'Completed Sucessfully!' message for the RunTitan stage, but I don't actually have any final output.
